named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Issue of ECLAC's FOCUS magazine on AI for Caribbean sustainable development. It features UNESCO's article on the draft Caribbean AI Policy Roadmap, an overview of AI governance in the Caribbean, and an interview with Craig Ramlal on regulating AI. It stresses responsible, rights-based, inclusive AI governance. Robotics is not a focus.
key_provisions_or_claims: Regulatory oversight is essential for AI to support the SDGs, equity and inclusion.
UNESCO presents the draft Caribbean AI Policy Roadmap for comment, implementing its 2019 Recommendation.
Caribbean governance efforts include Jamaica's AI task force and the CARICOM Declaration on Autonomous Weapons Systems.
Data protection legislation and data access are needed for Caribbean AI, given data scarcity.
A UN High-level Advisory Body on AI was formed in October 2023 to bridge governance initiatives.
